title: Beatriz Mojica: From Criticizing AMLO to Coordinating Morena in Guerrero
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
content:
_This article by[José Shaddai Olvera
Torres](https://elchamuco.com.mx/author/shaddai/) originally appeared in the
[September 18, 2026 edition of El Chamuco y los Hijos del
Averno](https://elchamuco.com.mx/2026/09/18/beatriz-mojica-morena-
guerrero-2027/), a Mexican political satire and news magazine._

Beatriz Mojica Morga was designated by Morena as state coordinator of the
Defense of the Transformation and National Sovereignty in Guerrero, a position
that **makes her the party 's profile to compete for the governorship in the
2027 elections**.

The appointment comes after an internal process in which different party
profiles took part, and amid questions about Mojica's political trajectory and
her past party affiliations.

The now-Morena member has a trajectory **linked primarily to the Party of the
Democratic Revolution (PRD)** , an organization she later left to join Morena.

https://x.com/Beatriz_Mojica/status/2100771092717515153

## "Never. I Don't Share Authoritarian Visions"

One of the antecedents that recirculated after her designation is an interview
given to the program Tragaluz, hosted by Fernando del Collado.

In that conversation, when Mojica was still a member of the PRD, she was asked
whether at some point she would join the political project of Andrés Manuel
López Obrador.

Her answer was: "Never. I don't share authoritarian visions."

In the same interview, speaking about the possibility of integrating different
political forces, Mojica maintained that citizens should decide and asserted
that López Obrador had "self-excluded."

Mojica later joined Morena and held positions within the party. Her trajectory
also includes a candidacy for the governorship of Guerrero in 2015 for the PRD
and the Labor Party (PT).

## In 2018 She Backed Ricardo Anaya

Another antecedent of her political trajectory corresponds to the 2018
presidential elections.

In that process, Mojica was a member of the PRD and **publicly backed the
presidential candidacy of Ricardo Anaya** , then the standard-bearer of the
Por México al Frente coalition, made up of the PAN, PRD and Movimiento
Ciudadano.

In a campaign ad registered with the Electoral Tribunal of the Federal
Judicial Power, Mojica stated: "Ricardo Anaya is a brilliant and brave man."

In another campaign spot she noted that she knew Anaya and that he was "an
honest man."

That same year, the PRD's National Council approved Anaya's presidential
candidacy and the lists for Congress, among them Mojica's candidacy for the
Senate by proportional representation.

## Her Political Relationship With Ángel Aguirre

Another element of her trajectory is her relationship with the former governor
of Guerrero, Ángel Aguirre Rivero.

Mojica held the Secretariat of Social Development of Guerrero during Aguirre's
administration and previously held other posts in his government. She was also
the PRD's candidate for the state governorship in 2015.

Her political relationship with Aguirre has again been mentioned in the
context of her designation by Morena, particularly due to the accusations and
judicial proceedings related to the Ayotzinapa case.

In August 2026, Aguirre was detained by the Attorney General's Office in an
investigation related to alleged crimes of **obstruction of justice and forced
disappearance in the context of the Ayotzinapa case**. Those accusations
correspond to the investigation against the former governor and do not by
themselves imply responsibility on Mojica's part.

## From PRD Candidate to Morena Coordinator

Mojica's party journey reflects a change from her public position of previous
years.

After her time in the PRD, she joined Morena and later reached the Senate.
Now, her designation as state coordinator places her within the process of
defining Morena's candidacy for Guerrero in 2027.

The appointment also generated questions and differences within the political
space that accompanies Morena in Guerrero. The decision has been described as
part of the internal dispute over the definition of the state candidacy.

For now, the designation as coordinator constitutes Morena's internal step
prior to the definition of the formal candidacy for the 2027 elections.
